tools.name: day_of_week
tools.description: Get the day of the week for a given date. Use for questions like 'what day was July 4 1776' or 'what day of the week is Christmas this year'.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. '2026-12-25' or '1776-07-04'

tools.name: week_number
tools.description: Get the ISO 8601 week number for a given date. Use for questions like 'what week of the year is March 15'.

tools.name: date_diff
tools.description: Calculate the difference between two dates in days, weeks, months, or years. Use for questions like 'how many days until Christmas' or 'how old is someone born on 1990-05-15'.

tools.name: date_add
tools.description: Add or subtract days/weeks/months/years from a date. Use for questions like 'what date is 90 days from now' or 'what was the date 3 weeks ago'.

amount.description: Number of units to add (negative to subtract)

tools.name: unix_to_date
tools.description: Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds since 1970-01-01) to a human-readable UTC date. Use for questions like 'what date is timestamp 1700000000'.

tools.name: date_to_unix
tools.description: Convert a date to a Unix timestamp (seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC). Use for questions like 'what is the Unix timestamp for 2026-01-01'.

tools.name: is_leap_year
tools.description: Check whether a given year is a leap year. Use for questions like 'is 2024 a leap year' or 'was 1900 a leap year'.
